scope: Official documentation baseline for Moon+ Reader Pro. MF-01 through MF-21 describe advertised capabilities and one documented compatibility limitation, not application test results.

product.name: Moon+ Reader Pro
limitations: Public package identity does not authenticate a supplied APK or establish its signing certificate, version code, or runtime behavior.

changes: New Double-Tap To Zoom option for PDF, DjVu, and comic books.
New Show my rating on book cover option.
Optimized CSS rendering for embedded font styles.
Customize mini status bar text with only color or font.
Bookmarks-tab management allows associating a missing book file with a new file.
limitations: The date is the visible Play listing update date, not a verified first-release timestamp.
These five observed release notes are not a complete version history or a test of the listed changes.

features.title: Broad ebook/document formats
features.description: Play lists EPUB, PDF, DjVu, AZW3, MOBI, FB2, PRC, CHM, CBZ, CBR, UMD, DOCX, ODT, RTF, TXT, HTML, MHT/MHTML, Markdown, WEBP, RAR, ZIP, and OPDS.
limitations: OPDS is catalog access. Listed formats do not establish identical speech, selection, or annotation behavior across formats.

features.title: Pro text-to-speech
features.description: Pro advertises shake-to-speak and support for TTS engines.
limitations: Engine availability and document text extraction are separate dependencies. The claim does not establish OCR for scanned pages.

features.title: Background speech
features.description: FAQ covers TTS stopping with the screen off and battery restrictions affecting both the reader and TTS engine.
limitations: This is an existing documented workflow, not a successful background-playback test on every Android device.

features.title: Gestures, hardware keys, hands-free controls
features.description: Headset/Bluetooth keys, tilt actions, customizable taps/swipes/keys, five auto-scroll modes, brightness gestures, and page animations are advertised.
limitations: Exact audio-focus, lock-screen, Bluetooth-reconnect, and accessibility interactions were not tested.

features.title: PDF forms, annotations, handwriting
features.description: The Pro PDF feature list includes form filling, highlighting, annotations, and handwriting.
limitations: Individual form types, annotation save semantics, and interoperability with other viewers require separate fixture tests.

features.title: PDF reading controls
features.description: PDF speech, auto-scroll, smart scroll lock, night mode, six additional PDF themes, landscape dual-page mode, statistics, sync, and flip animation are advertised.
limitations: Native PDF text reflow is not settled by the reviewed official documentation. Separate supplied-artifact static evidence APK-PDF-001 records a text-reflow code path; official-build runtime behavior remains unverified. Zoom, extraction, and reflow are not interchangeable.

features.title: Ebook annotations, lookup, and sharing
features.description: Highlights, notes/bookmarks, offline/online dictionary integration, translation, and sharing are documented.
limitations: Dictionary integration does not establish a complete bundled offline dictionary or identical behavior for every format.

features.title: Themes and typography
features.description: Ten-plus embedded themes, day/night switching, font scaling/styles, line spacing, colors, justification, hyphenation, and paragraph/whitespace controls are documented.
limitations: Eye-care language is a publisher claim, not an independently measured health outcome or layout-conformance test.

features.title: Custom fonts/backgrounds
features.description: FAQ names TTF, OTF, and TTC fonts and the Visual Options > Font Name/Background Images controls.
limitations: FAQ folder guidance reflects older Android conventions. Current import, picker, and storage behavior is untested.

features.title: Publisher-formatting preview
features.description: FAQ recommends Preview mode with publisher formattings in Misc Options for table content.
limitations: An existing fallback is documented; table fidelity and setting persistence still require a named fixture and active mode.

features.title: EPUB3 media and footnotes
features.description: Play advertises EPUB3 audio/video content and popup footnotes.
limitations: This does not establish full EPUB3 conformance or every media-overlay behavior.

features.title: Reading-state/annotation sync
features.description: Dropbox/WebDAV position sync and backup are documented. FAQ describes position upload on Pause, checking on Resume, then background highlights/notes/bookmarks sync.
limitations: Position arrival does not establish annotation-sync completion. Conflict handling, retries, and completion visibility were not tested.

features.title: Google Drive and cloud shelf/files
features.description: Pro policy explicitly describes Google Drive, Dropbox, and WebDAV access plus reading-state, annotation, and shelf-file synchronization.
limitations: Omission of Drive from shorter feature lists is not evidence of absence. Authentication, retention, and encryption behavior were not verified.

features.title: Backup, restore, annotation export
features.description: FAQ documents Options > Backup for all books/settings, Bookmarks dialog > Export > Export to file for the current book, and Backup/Restore migration from Free to Pro.
limitations: Export formats, completeness, merging, restore fidelity, and cross-reader portability require independent tests.

features.title: Library/file management
features.description: Shelves, favorites, downloads, authors/tags, custom covers, import/search, file management, widgets, and book shortcuts are advertised.
limitations: Automatic deduplication and content-based book identity are not established. The v10.8 notes already document missing-file relinking.

features.title: Cover-cache repair
features.description: FAQ provides My Shelf > Rebuild book covers and discusses external cleaning tools removing cover caches.
limitations: Current cover-cache location, repair behavior, and interaction with external cleaners were not tested.

features.title: OPDS/calibre
features.description: Play advertises online libraries and personal calibre servers; FAQ explains adding a server through Online Library > Add new catalog.
limitations: Authentication methods, pagination, protocol variants, and server compatibility were not tested.

features.title: Statistics and focus aids
features.description: Per-book reading time/speed, a six-style reading ruler, and a blue-light filter up to 95% are advertised.
limitations: These describe advertised options, not measured health, cognitive, battery, or performance benefits.

features.title: Orientation, dual-page layout, startup lock
features.description: Play lists four screen orientations, landscape dual-page reading, and startup password protection with fingerprint recognition.
limitations: Two pages of one book do not establish simultaneous two-document reading. Startup locking does not establish file, backup, or cloud encryption.

features.title: Localization
features.description: English homepage/download page state 46 languages; the older Chinese page states 40.
limitations: Counts are page-specific claims. Translation completeness and the exact language set of a v10.8 build were not tested.

features.title: DRM compatibility limitation
features.description: FAQ explicitly states that DRM-protected books are unsupported.
limitations: This entry records a documented limitation, not a supported capability or reproduced defect. No DRM-removal workflow was performed.

unknowns.title: Official PDF text-reflow documentation and runtime behavior
unknowns.description: Reviewed official sources do not settle the PDF reflow interface or combinations with speech, selection, and annotations. Separate static findings establish a text-reflow code path only in the supplied artifact.
limitations: A bounded documentation search does not justify an absence claim. APK-PDF-001 does not authenticate the artifact or verify official-release runtime behavior; inspect the actual workflow before requesting a refinement.

related_evidence.scope: Separate supplied-artifact evidence of PDF text-reflow, settings-search, and Readwise-upload paths; not additional documented MF capabilities or application tests.
limitations: Official provenance is unverified. Static code presence does not establish runtime success, usability, feature parity with an official distribution, or successful Readwise delivery.

documentation_findings.title: Pro privacy-policy wording needs clarification
documentation_findings.description: Play and later Pro-policy sections deny collection/sharing, while earlier Pro-policy sections describe third-party services and error Log Data that may include IP/device details.
limitations: This is a wording inquiry, not evidence of undisclosed transmission or a legal violation. The combined policy's AdMob reference does not establish AdMob in Pro.

sources.scope: Official homepage: features, contact, regional distribution notice.
limitations: Unversioned page; no reliable visible revision date established.

sources.scope: Pro Play listing: package, advertised features, App support, Data safety, v10.8 notes; visible update date 2026-10-16.
limitations: A fuller page read also recovered support and Data safety fields. Listing metadata does not authenticate an APK or establish first-release timing.

sources.scope: Official FAQ: Pro benefits, background TTS, backup/export, fonts, table preview, sync sequence, calibre, covers, and DRM limitation.
limitations: A fuller read recovered sections omitted by initial reader-mode extraction. Unversioned FAQ contains older Android examples.

sources.scope: Official package links, one-payment/lifetime-upgrade statement, localization count, PDFViewer SDK attribution, and qualified regional downloads.
limitations: Regional notice expiry 2027-10-10 is not a global app-expiry rule. No exact PDF SDK version was established.

sources.scope: Pro-specific privacy policy linked by Play: collection language, cloud access/sync/storage descriptions, permissions, and privacy contact.
limitations: Full read has date-only retrieval precision. No explicit policy revision date or actual network behavior established.

sources.scope: Combined free/Pro policy linked by homepage; third-party list includes AdMob; privacy contact.
limitations: Combined policy must not be used alone to attribute an SDK or collection behavior to Pro.

sources.scope: Chinese Moon page, including its page-specific 40-language statement.
limitations: Older page content is not an authoritative build-specific language inventory; copyright footer is not a revision date.

sources.scope: Official site's collection of historical third-party press excerpts, inspected for version-history context.
limitations: Returned content was truncated. Reprinted coverage is not a primary feature specification or a complete release history.
All MF entries are documented claims, not runtime-observation records; MF-21 is a compatibility limitation.
Official pages are a dated snapshot; unversioned documentation cannot certify every v10.8 interaction.
Complete release history, a mandatory report format, a verified in-app reporting path, an official public tracker, and a support SLA were not established.
Performance, accessibility conformance, encryption, and privacy behavior were not measured in this documentation review.
The supplied APK's separate artifact record must retain its own provenance limits; these sources do not authenticate that artifact.
The unresolved Reader Pro identity, comparator qualifications, and source-pinned README/license evidence are explained in knowledge/moon-baseline.md.
No emails, upstream issues, or upstream pull requests were submitted for this work. Drafts live in knowledge/reporting.md.
